title: VFX Mega Pack R2 — 60 Action Candidate Map

manualVisualReviewActions.reason: Impact Cut V6 reads as a compact target hit, not yet as the wide directional cleave expected from a greatsword.
Healing V5 reads primarily as restoration; it must be compared with a compact holy staff-strike before promotion.
Wind Ball has travel but no unmistakable arrow silhouette; verify the intended longbow read at tactical scale.
Fire Ball reads as magic unless its firing/impact staging establishes the hand-cannon identity.
Jump Wind needs an in-combat check that it reads as protective interception rather than a generic movement puff.
Blood Burst v10 has low visible occupancy on its contact sheet and must prove a readable self-aura at 4 AP.
Jump Wind v2 needs a landing impact layer or stronger source staging to sell an offensive leap.
Stab V3 is structurally compatible but does not yet prove an ultimate-scale line identity.
Flamethrower 002 is the semantic cone candidate, but its native orientation and coverage need runtime visual approval.
Positive Buff V3 is a useful support layer but may not provide a sufficiently grounded sanctuary field by itself.
Healing V7 needs a final visual check for an ultimate-scale miracle rather than a regular heal.
Positive Buff V5 risks reading like UI arrows instead of a signature harmony ultimate.
Wind Rings are a preparatory aura; validate that the full presentation still reads as a moving archer leap.
Arrow Indicator V4 is a targeting-style source, not yet a validated falling-arrow field effect.
Arrow Indicator V5 is a directional marker, not yet a validated signature projectile.
Circle Cut Out V1 is only a base marker and does not independently communicate a mechanical jaw trap.

runtimeCopyPolicy: No commercial source PNG is copied by this audit. Each entry remains a source-pack candidate until an explicit promotion gate.
